formula_identity: For each team, arithmetic mean of per-game ORtg, DRtg, NetRtg and Pace over the last up to 10 completed games strictly before the target game; minimum 3 completed games. Then TEAM_A minus TEAM_B for net, pace, offense and defense; pregame_games_min is the lesser sample count.
acquisition_query_template: <team full name> last 10 games pace offensive rating defensive rating each game WNBA
required_checks: all rows are completed games before target game
arithmetic mean across returned per-game rows, not provider aggregate shortcut
baseline capture/as-of no more than 36 hours before LIVE state
source URL or provider result identity and content fingerprint recorded
fail_closed: provider returns aggregate only without per-game ORtg/DRtg/Pace rows

legacy_2026_possession_asset.role: verification/replay only after freshness audit; not assumed current for live baseline
